title: Colorful Italian Alley
description: A sunlit narrow cobblestone alleyway lined with vibrant yellow and orange Mediterranean buildings featuring arched doorways, blue shutters, and stone steps. The scene is filled with abundant potted plants and hanging baskets overflowing with bright pink and yellow flowers under a clear blue sky.
